title: Desk bridge v0: account
description: The person's endue ID on this desk (ADR 0089, ADR 0111). Signing in follows the OAuth 2.0 device authorization grant (RFC 8628) with PKCE (RFC 7636, S256) through the endue AI platform's auth endpoints: the desk asks for a code, opens the endue ID page at auth.endue.ai where the person signs in or creates an account and confirms the code, and waits for the session in the background. The core keeps the session, renews it and sends the access token to the brain as its bearer token; no token crosses the bridge. Every call needs account:manage. account.status, account.signIn and account.signOut answer the same AccountStatus, and changes arrive as account.changed. account.settings.get and account.settings.update read and change the signed-in account's own settings on endue, the ones endue.ai's Account and General settings show (ADR 0130): the name and the picture's address, the display language and the time zone, and which notifications reach the person in endue's inbox. Signed out they are signed_out; endue out of reach is offline.

AccountState.description: signed-out: no endue ID on this desk. signing-in: a code waits for the person in the browser. signed-in: the desk holds a session and the brain gets its token.

AccountScreen.description: Which endue ID page the person starts on: sign-in, or sign-up to create an account. Either way they end signed in.

AccountProblem.description: Which kind of problem the last step ran into, for the runtime to word: offline (endue could not be reached), denied (turned down in the browser), expired (the code ran out), slow-down (too many attempts; endue asked the desk to wait), unavailable (endue answered with a server error), suspended (the account is suspended), rejected (endue refused to renew the session, which the desk keeps), session-expired (the session ended, so the desk signed out), failed (anything else).

AccountSignIn.description: Where and with which code the person finishes signing in, while the state is signing-in.

userCode.description: The code the person confirms on the page, for example WDJB-MJHT.

verificationUri.description: The page where the person enters the code: endue ID's device page.

verificationUriComplete.description: The same page with the code already in it, and the sign-up hint when screen is sign-up: the page the desk opened, and opens again when asked.

AccountProfile.description: Who is signed in, from the platform's GET /api/v1/users/me: what the account bar shows. A field the account does not have is left out.

displayName.description: The name the person goes by on endue.

avatarUrl.description: The person's picture as a data: URL the core fetched, so the webview needs no remote image source.

AccountStatus.description: The account as it is now. signIn is there while signing-in, profile while signed-in; problem says, for people, why the last step did not go through, and reason which kind of problem it was.

AccountParams.description: Parameters of account.status, account.signOut and account.settings.get: the scope alone.

AccountSignInParams.description: Parameters of account.signIn: the scope, and the page to start on (sign-in when absent).

AccountStatusRequest.description: The account as it is now.

AccountSignInRequest.description: Start signing in: the answer is signing-in with the code and the page the desk opened. A sign-in already under way answers as it is and opens its page again, with the screen asked for; one on a desk that is signed in starts over and keeps the old session until the new one is there.

AccountSignOutRequest.description: End the session: the desk asks endue to revoke it, then forgets it on this desk and stops any sign-in under way. The brain gets no token after it.

AccountSignInResult.description: Result of account.signIn: signing-in with the code, or why it could not start (problem and reason).

AccountUserStatus.description: The account's standing on endue: active, inactive, or suspended.

AccountUser.description: Who the person is on endue, from GET /api/v1/users/me, as endue.ai's Account settings show it. displayName and avatarUrl are absent while never set. avatarUrl is the picture's address as endue keeps it, text to edit: the desk shows account.status's picture and never loads this address.

id.description: The user id people quote to endue's support.

AccountLanguage.description: A display language as an IETF BCP 47 tag: en-US, ja-JP, de-DE, fr-FR, ko-KR.

AccountTimeZone.description: An IANA time zone name: Asia/Seoul, America/New_York, UTC.

AccountNotificationKind.description: The kinds of endue notification endue.ai's settings let the person turn off: conversation-reply (an agent finished answering while they were away), routine-completed, routine-failed and routine-skipped (a scheduled run finished, failed, or was skipped at a usage limit), agent-notice (an agent decided they need to know something during a scheduled run).

AccountNotification.description: Whether one kind of notification reaches the person in endue's inbox (in-app).

AccountSettingsPart.description: A part of the account's settings endue keeps apart from the account itself: preferences (the language and the time zone) and notifications.

AccountSettingsProblem.description: A part endue did not answer for: the bridge error code it would have been, and a sentence for people.

AccountSettings.description: The signed-in account's settings on endue, read at once. The account itself must answer; a part that does not is left out (language and timeZone) or empty (notifications) and named in problems. language is absent while the person never chose one, and so is a stored value that is not a BCP 47 tag; notifications lists the five kinds in endue.ai's order.

AccountSettingsUpdateParams.description: Parameters of account.settings.update: the scope and what to change, at least one of them. displayName is trimmed; an empty avatarUrl clears the picture.

avatarUrl.description: An http or https address, or empty to clear the picture.

AccountSettingsGetRequest.description: The signed-in account's settings: the account, its language and time zone, and its notifications, read side by side.

AccountSettingsUpdateRequest.description: Change some settings on endue, so endue.ai and the desk show the same: the name and the picture's address, then the language and the time zone, then the notifications, each only when given. A change endue refuses stops there with its error; what was saved before it stays saved. A changed name or picture reaches account.status's profile and goes out as account.changed.

AccountSettingsUpdateResult.description: Result of account.settings.update: the settings now.

AccountChangedEvent.description: The account changed: a sign-in began, finished or failed, the session was renewed with a problem or ended, the profile arrived or changed, or the desk signed out. Sent to holders of account:manage.
